sections.heading: Getting started
paragraphs: Dina was exploring study and university. The aim was to have a clear, natural conversation in English. Dina said, “What are you studying at university?” A friend replied, “I'm majoring in computer science.” Dina said, “Which year are you in?” A friend replied, “I'm in my final year.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “I have a lecture at nine.” A friend replied, “The professor explained the topic clearly.” Dina said, “I need to review my notes.” A friend replied, “We have an assignment due next week.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “Have you started working on it?”

sections.heading: In conversation
paragraphs: The conversation continued, and Dina practiced listening and responding with care. Dina said, “I've finished the first part.” A friend replied, “I'm struggling with one question.” Dina said, “Could we study together?” A friend replied, “The library is a quiet place to study.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “I'll reserve a study room.” A friend replied, “Let's compare our answers.” Dina said, “I want to understand the method, not just memorize it.” A friend replied, “The exam covers five chapters.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “I should start preparing early.”

sections.heading: Practicing details
paragraphs: Next, Dina practiced phrases that could help with common problems and decisions. Dina said, “I made a revision schedule.” A friend replied, “I take short breaks to stay focused.” Dina said, “The deadline has been extended.” A friend replied, “Please upload your work before midnight.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “Our group has four students.” A friend replied, “We divided the tasks fairly.” Dina said, “I'm responsible for the presentation.” A friend replied, “Could you check my slides?” They paused to remember the meaning.

sections.heading: Putting it together
paragraphs: Before finishing, Dina reviewed more useful sentences and noticed real improvement. Dina said, “I need to cite my sources properly.” A friend replied, “I learned a lot from this project.” Dina said, “The feedback was encouraging.” A friend replied, “I might apply for an internship.” They paused to remember the meaning. Dina said, “Practical experience is valuable.” A friend replied, “I hope to graduate next year.” Dina said, “I'm proud of how far I've come.” A friend replied, “Learning doesn't stop after graduation.” They paused to remember the meaning.
